fields.help_en:
The key-value pairs of the Secret. This parameter is required. The value must be a JSON object.

For more information about configuration items, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/463383.html.

The status of the API call or a POP error code. Valid values:

2xx: The request was successful.

3xx: The request was redirected.

4xx: A request error occurred.

5xx: A server error occurred
